classification.reason: This is documented as KI-122 in known_issues.md: bulk-moving tasks drops custom field values if the destination board lacks a matching custom field, which is expected behavior, not data loss requiring escalation.

draft.reply:
Hi,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the scare. What you're seeing is expected behavior tied to how bulk moves handle custom fields, not data loss on our end.

When tasks are bulk-moved to a different board, any custom field (like your "Priority Score") will be cleared if the destination board doesn't have a matching custom field set up. This is a known, documented behavior rather than a bug.

To avoid this in the future, please confirm that the destination board has a matching custom field (same name/type) before doing a bulk move — that way the values carry over correctly.

Unfortunately, since the field values were cleared during the move rather than stored elsewhere, we're not able to restore the original "Priority Score" values for the 20 tasks that were already moved. If you'd like, you can add a matching "Priority Score" custom field to the destination board going forward so future moves preserve this data.

Let us know if you have any other questions.

Best,
Loopwise Support
